description: OpenCode via its native ACP subcommand (registry package opencode-ai). Subscription access stays in your OpenCode login; Garuda never reads it.
warnings: Vendor capability mediation is negotiated at handshake; strict garuda-only policies may be refused — review before mutating runs.
setup: 1. Install the OpenCode CLI (registry package opencode-ai) and log in. 2. Verify: opencode --version. Garuda never reads your OpenCode auth configuration.
